prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Baytown, Texas, and has neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1355; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you reported in Baytown, Texas. Do I have your permission to record this call?

A: Yes, that's fine.

Q: Please state your full name and the best number to reach you.

A: I'd rather keep my personal details off the recording, but you have my claim file. Go ahead with your questions.

Q: That's acceptable. Can you walk me through what happened when the other vehicle made contact with yours?

A: I was in the right lane on the main road and needed to move over to the left lane because my exit was coming up. I checked my mirror, saw the lane looked clear, and started to merge. The other car came up beside me and clipped the rear quarter panel of my vehicle. It pushed me toward the median, and I had to correct the steering quickly.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before you started your lane change?

A: I didn't see it in the mirror at that moment. It seemed to be in my blind spot, and I didn't catch it until the contact happened.

Q: Were you able to drive your vehicle from the scene?

A: Yes, it was still drivable, but the rear panel was damaged and the car pulled a little to one side.

Q: Have you been seen by a medical provider since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic the same day. I have pain in my neck and lower back. The neck is stiff when I turn my head, and my back aches after sitting for more than twenty minutes. The provider diagnosed a neck and back strain and gave me muscle relaxers and a referral to physical therapy.

Q: Is there anything else you would like to add before we finish?

A: Only that I want the repairs and medical care handled as quickly as possible, since I'm still having trouble with daily tasks.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
